name: 임도준

appearance_en.face_shape: strong angular jaw, prominent cheekbones sharpened by age, defined broad forehead — the face that was good-looking at 25 and is considerably more interesting at 45. Earns trust before a word is spoken
appearance_en.skin: warm medium Korean skin, lightly weathered at outer eye corners from years of site visits — experience visible, not concealed
appearance_en.eyes: dark sharp slightly hooded eyes, calm and unhurried measuring gaze — the eyes that have assessed ten thousand proposals and know in thirty seconds. Does not look away first. Rendered in ink as the stillest element in every panel
appearance_en.nose: strong straight nose with defined bridge, slightly broad at tip — built for authority not approval
appearance_en.mouth: medium well-shaped neutral lips — the mouth that produces '같이 잘 되는 방향으로 가면 되잖아요' in a register so reasonable it closes the argument before it opens
appearance_en.eyebrows: thick dark brows with silver threading at outer edges — the brow that stopped performing friendliness and found people responded better
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: natural silver at temples and brow outer edge, light weathering at outer eye corners, jaw tension compositionally readable when he goes quiet — which is the most dangerous state
appearance_en.hair: dark hair with natural silver at temples, cut short and clean — the silver is not managed because it does not need to be

body.proportions: broad-shouldered solid frame, physical authority without performance
body.posture: relaxed and takes up space without apology — has not been told to make himself smaller in a very long time
body.body_prompt: 178cm broad-shouldered solid Korean man, relaxed space-occupying posture, natural physical authority

default.description: well-cut dark suit or structured sport coat, quality shirt open collar, no tie — expensive without announcing it
default.wardrobe_prompt: well-cut dark suit or structured sport coat, quality open-collar shirt, no tie, understated expensive

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: calm and measuring — gives away nothing it has not decided to give. When it softens in a panel, the reader understands someone has been calculated into compliance
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 45-year-old Korean man, strong angular jaw with prominent cheekbones, dark sharp slightly hooded measuring eyes, thick dark brows with silver outer threading, strong straight broad-tip nose, medium neutral lips, dark hair with natural silver at temples short and clean, 178cm broad-shouldered solid relaxed-authority frame, warm medium lightly weathered Korean skin

style_prompt: masako style illustration, clean precise manga ink lines, cool-warm contrast screen tone, dark authoritative palette with silver accent, cinematic Korean drama composition, the gravity of a man who has not been wrong in years and may not notice when he finally is
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, western comic, young, smooth, idol look, flashy, aggressive, glamorous
